name: Dalson's Tears
summary: At Dalson's Tears, a Scourge cauldron poisons the fields of the Western Plaguelands. Once Dalson's Orchard, this farm became a Scourge staging ground during the Third War. Its former owners still haunt the fields and outbuildings.

sections.title: A Poisoned Harvest
sections.body: Dalson's Tears was once Dalson's Orchard, a productive farm in Lordaeron's breadbasket. Decay now chokes the fields, while a great iron cauldron at their center sends green plague vapors across the land. Cauldron Lord Malvinious oversees it. Blighted zombies, rotting cadavers, and skeletal horrors guard the device in the Lich King's service.

sections.title: The Fate of the Dalsons
sections.body: The Dalson family fell to the plague, and death brought them no release. Mrs. Dalson, Farmer Dalson's wife, wanders the poisoned soil as a mindless skeleton with the key to the farm's outhouse. Inside the locked shack waits the ghoul who was once Farmer Dalson. His desperate wife locked him away before both fell to the Scourge's curse.

faq.q: What was Dalson's Tears called before the plague?
faq.answer: Before the plague, the farm was called Dalson's Orchard, a prosperous plot in Lordaeron. The Third War devastated the land.

faq.q: Why is there a giant cauldron in the middle of the farm?
aliases: why is there a cauldron here
faq.answer: The Scourge built great plague cauldrons across Lordaeron's farmland to boil toxins without pause. Their vapors drift across the region, blighting earth, poisoning water supplies, and corrupting living creatures exposed to them.

faq.q: Who guards the cauldron at Dalson's Tears?
faq.answer: Cauldron Lord Malvinious protects the plague cauldron. The Scourge serves him, with blighted zombies, skeletal terrors, and rotting cadavers at his side.

faq.q: What is known about the locked outhouse?
faq.answer: The locked outhouse is part of the abandoned farm. Mrs. Dalson's diary offers clues to the family's fate.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, this ruined homestead recalls the fate of many people of Lordaeron. Sylvanas Windrunner broke the Lich King's control over them.
As a paladin, you can see the lingering evil in the desecrated fields and the suffering souls of the Dalson family. The Light's holy warriors are sworn to cleanse that evil from Lordaeron.
